mapper.select: SELECT nsi.ordinal, nb.name AS brandName, nc.name AS categoryName, np.name AS productName, nsi.qty_box, nsi.qty_order FROM newbie_sample_items AS nsi LEFT JOIN newbie_category AS nc ON nsi.category_id = nc.id LEFT JOIN newbie_brand AS nb ON nsi.brand_id = nb.id LEFT JOIN newbie_product AS np ON nsi.product_id = np.id WHERE nsi.req_id = #{reqId} AND nsi.is_deleted = 0 AND nc.is_deleted = 0 AND nb.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY nsi.ordinal ASC
